notes.title: Hotfix v2.2.5 (v0.3)
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug where buttons would not return to their original animation position, this additionally fixed any issues with the menu disappearing due to animation issues.

Added missing Localization keys for new menu options (Skins, Customization)

Removed extraneous options 

Updated Credits, credits scroll speed is much faster now

Updated Linux Build to Latest Verstion (v2.2.5)

Mac Build coming soon.

notes.title: UI Hotfix
notes.notes: Fixed issue where fading prevented menus from working properly, clicking a button will now automatically reset the menu fade in and out animation

notes.title: 🛠️ Patch 03 🛠️
notes.notes:
Fixed several crashes, errors, or bugs related to unit deployment, profile options saving, profile layers, camera control (ingame), cell selection, unit deployment, asset loading, Localization, Music and SFX,        and added features from PLAYNYC-based playtesting.

Look out for hotfixes related to Font Size in UI and Tooltips in the near future. Their options are toggleable (and will be saved for the user).

Updated UI elements for clarity during mech market purchases and added NEW UNITS! Enjoy the use of Hardsuits, and Gunwalkers in addition to Bipeds and Quads on the Battlefield. Now available via the ingame store. 

Maps can have obstacles spawned on them, there are versions of maps with and without obstacles, this can be toggled in the Custom Game menu

Added Terrain Effects, some tiles can come with status effects now based on terrain conditions (standing in water for example)

Added Game Modes, they are in the early phases for now but upcoming patches will continue to add on modes and respond to player feedback

New Map added: Beachhead

Added the Arsenal View, allowing players to view and toggle between their decks visually, we are also adding a Customization menu in the near future as an addition to this menu.

Added Campaigns to main menu, Stay Tuned!

notes.title: Dev Diary 02 - Update Notes for April 14th
notes.notes:
Changelog(4/14/25):
QoL

Localization Support (Thai, Indonesian, Japanese and Chinese)

Audio Controls effect both menu and ingame(both music and sfx)

Added SFX to indicate button hover

UI(Main Menu):
fixed Custom Game Menu can no longer start with a blank map; none option for Maps in Custom Game no longer results in a white map (bugfix)

Replaced `Grassland`, `Highland`, and `Tartarus` with new map artwork (content)

Quickplay AI uses randomized Deck now (enhancement)

Custom Game can  now be started with or without Deploy Phase enabled (bugfix)

Units:
Fixed asset rotations and attack range drawing for more advanced mechs(both Union and Federation)
Added Dash VFX

Ingame:
Added A How To Play at game start

fixed issues where some players reported only the Federation spawn working correctly and not the Union

Numerous bugixes related to selection, attack indication, added visual indications for unit interaction

Fixed bug where system messages piled up during combat, they now cascade in order of events and clarified numerous system messages based on player feedback

Fixed issues with move marker draw radius

Reworked Dice Roller to include descriptions of dice roll

Tiles with dead entities are marked but considered unoccupied

Fixed a bug where AI was treating dead entities as though they weren’t

Fixed save roll to ignore disabled and dead entities, on death entities now lose all status effects
Added pause like behavior to Victory Screen

New rotation behavior, can rotate after moving (optional)

We're working on the following features currently before releasing this patch:
Obstacles
Tweaking Night and Day Cycle
Adding a Weather System
Tile Effects
Working on a PlayerConfig object to hold all options values
Working on Customization, Animated Units, and related elements
Tutorial Level
Customization of Non-Animated assets (Skins)
Controller Support/Interaction 
Entity Hover-over SFX
VFX for all unit actions (currently only the Dash action has an associated VFX)

See You on the Battlefield!
Team Ferrous
